column3: “Over songs of thanksgiving” is rendered “in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.”
“Were before them to duties” is rendered “stood opposite them in their service divisions.” NASB reads “Unni” as the name read aloud.
NASB supplies “became the father of” for the last name.
NASB reads “Malluchi,” the name read aloud, for the written “Melicu.”
The Hebrew gives no name after “Miniamin”; NASB keeps the gap.
“Recorded leaders of fathers” is rendered “the heads of fathers' households were registered”; NASB supplies “so were.” “On the reign” is rendered “in the reign.”
“The scroll of the matters of the days” is rendered “the Book of the Chronicles.”
“Were before them” is rendered “opposite them,” and “by the commandment of” as “as prescribed by.”
“Keeping guard” is rendered “keeping watch,” and “storerooms” as “storehouses.”
“People sought” is rendered “they sought out”; NASB supplies “so that,” “hymns,” and “to the accompaniment of.” The two stringed instruments are reversed.
“The fields of Geba” is rendered “their fields in Geba.”
